spans.text: But that's what YOU would say, Prof!

units.rawText: Sol laughs, and it makes her look beautiful.
units.displayText: Sol laughs, and it makes her look beautiful.

spans.text: Sol laughs, and it makes her look beautiful.

units.rawText: Still, when I see you do that, it helps me figure out what I want to do—At the very least, I know what I want to do now!
units.displayText: Still, when I see you do that, it helps me figure out what I want to do—At the very least, I know what I want to do now!

spans.text: Still, when I see you do that, it helps me figure out what I want to do—At the very least, I know what I want to do now!

units.rawText: She raises her voice, just like when she's sharing amusing news, or when she's barging into my office, like when we're in battle and she proudly goes "just leave it to me".
units.displayText: She raises her voice, just like when she's sharing amusing news, or when she's barging into my office, like when we're in battle and she proudly goes "just leave it to me".

spans.text: She raises her voice, just like when she's sharing amusing news, or when she's barging into my office, like when we're in battle and she proudly goes "just leave it to me".

units.rawText: She's the forthright Sol once again, with the all-too-familiar smile on her face.
units.displayText: She's the forthright Sol once again, with the all-too-familiar smile on her face.

spans.text: She's the forthright Sol once again, with the all-too-familiar smile on her face.

units.rawText: She takes a deep breath, then hikes up her skirt and takes a step forward on the rock.
units.displayText: She takes a deep breath, then hikes up her skirt and takes a step forward on the rock.

spans.text: She takes a deep breath, then hikes up her skirt and takes a step forward on the rock.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: Just then, the fireworks rise into the air, and light and fire fill the sky.
units.displayText: Just then, the fireworks rise into the air, and light and fire fill the sky.

spans.text: Just then, the fireworks rise into the air, and light and fire fill the sky.

units.rawText: Professor! Make sure you keep watching me from now on!
units.displayText: Professor! Make sure you keep watching me from now on!

spans.text: Professor! Make sure you keep watching me from now on!

units.rawText: Or else it'll suck if you get lost!
units.displayText: Or else it'll suck if you get lost!

spans.text: Or else it'll suck if you get lost!

units.rawText: Her voice is as passionate as ever, with every ounce of her strength poured into it.
units.displayText: Her voice is as passionate as ever, with every ounce of her strength poured into it.

spans.text: Her voice is as passionate as ever, with every ounce of her strength poured into it.

units.rawText: Sol turns around, haloed in radiance, her expression playful yet serious.
units.displayText: Sol turns around, haloed in radiance, her expression playful yet serious.

spans.text: Sol turns around, haloed in radiance, her expression playful yet serious.

units.rawText: Things should be okay now that the ocean's heard us complaining, right?
units.displayText: Things should be okay now that the ocean's heard us complaining, right?

spans.text: Things should be okay now that the ocean's heard us complaining, right?

units.rawText: Hah, well, I think it should be fine...
units.displayText: Hah, well, I think it should be fine...

spans.text: Hah, well, I think it should be fine...

units.rawText: The sound of the fireworks exploding and Sol's incandescent smile gush forth, drowning out my words.
units.displayText: The sound of the fireworks exploding and Sol's incandescent smile gush forth, drowning out my words.

spans.text: The sound of the fireworks exploding and Sol's incandescent smile gush forth, drowning out my words.
